title: Building Vue app without plugin rejects a promise.
body:
If one is accidentally using `tauri build` in a vue app, the command will fail. The vue plugin adds necessary config for the build. It currently fails with a rejected promise as noted below.

```
yarn run v1.22.4
$ /home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/.bin/tauri build
[tauri]: running build
(node:14387) UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined
    at validateString (internal/validators.js:117:11)
    at Object.resolve (path.js:980:7)
    at ./src/helpers/tauri-config.ts.module.exports (/home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:425:39)
    at /home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:155:23
    at step (/home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:139:23)
    at Object.next (/home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:120:53)
    at /home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:114:71
    at new Promise (<anonymous>)
    at ./src/api/build.ts.__awaiter (/home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:110:12)
    at ./src/api/build.ts.module.exports (/home/runner/work/nota/nota/node_modules/@tauri-apps/tauri-webpack/node_modules/tauri/dist/api/build.js:151:45)
(node:14387) UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: Unhandled promise rejection. This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block, or by rejecting a promise which was not handled with .catch(). To terminate the node process on unhandled promise rejection, use the CLI flag `--unhandled-rejections=strict` (see https://nodejs.org/api/cli.html#cli_unhandled_rejections_mode). (rejection id: 1)
(node:14387) [DEP0018] DeprecationWarning: Unhandled promise rejections are deprecated. In the future, promise rejections that are not handled will terminate the Node.js process with a non-zero exit code.
Done in 1.01s.
```

The failure is expected, but the Promise that is failing needs to be caught as `(node:14387) [DEP0018] DeprecationWarning: Unhandled promise rejections are deprecated.`, and it will exit with a zero exit code. `In the future, promise rejections that are not handled will terminate the Node.js process with a non-zero exit code.`, but for now, a zero exit code indicates success in CI. We need to catch said promise and throw so it exits with a non-zero code. This will correctly fail in CI, and fix for the future deprecation.
